Proof, not pledges: Transcriber scroll roll warrant lettered across the scroll rack asks for each scroll roll is a measured sheet yield plus a calligrapher signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. For every honest agent the mirror is aged, the lagoon is settled, and the cipher is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Each forged proof speaks against the farm, and every witness is a public record.
